description: Stage-1 TIGHTENED recipe per director ruling D3/A4 2026-10-15 (state.md): a AND (b OR c) -- web-relevant CWE (branch a) AND (cvss >= cvss_min (b) OR has-public-exploit (c)). The design-2.3 strict union measured 213,152 records (a=93,282 / b=107,374 / c=52,154, artifacts/p2-join-stats.json) which was too big for the early-value slice; expected tightened size 30k-60k. Exploit records enter via the SLICED-CVE mirror (an EDB row is included when >= 1 of its resolved CVE refs is itself in the tightened slice) -- exploit rows carry no cwe_ids, so the literal a-branch is unsatisfiable for them; the mirror is the A4 composition sub-choice (design 2.3 'exploit kind: resolved-cve mirror', p2-join-stats slice_estimate.note delegates the choice to A4). Reference kinds per include_reference (A4 manifest config choice): the 32 web-relevant CWE catalog records and all 61 OWASP Top10 EN docs ride along (small, high matching context); cwe_category stays out (reference-only, excluded_from_index).
tuning_ruling: state.md 2026-10-15 DIRECTOR RULING D3/A4: if the measured count lands far outside 30k-60k, tighten (cvss_min -> 8.0) and note it. Stage 2 = FULL corpus (owner-approved, task.md ADDENDUM 2).
